title: Infused Crystal Casing
text: Use an Infused Spiritual Crystal on a Spiritual Crystal Block to form an Infused Crystal Casing. Its clear body and connecting trim match the Crystal Casing, but its rim glows pale white.
Both casings can wrap Create shafts and cogwheels. A wrench removes a standalone casing; wrenching an encased shaft toggles its axial connection, and sneak-wrenching removes the shell.
